description: The formula \(\exists x\;(y<x\land x<z)\) has no equivalent quantifier-free formula in the strict-order structure on the integers.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.QuantifierElimination.integer_between_no_shared_quantifier_free_equivalent :
  have this := Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.binaryRelStructure ℤ fun a b => a < b;
  ¬∃ ψ,
      ψ.IsQF ∧
        ∀ (a : Fin 2 → ℤ),
          Lemmatheca.Entry.QuantifierElimination.sharedBetweenFormula.Realize Empty.elim a ↔ ψ.Realize Empty.elim a
